lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in 6-8 discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots form a semi-regular grid pattern with higher density in the dorsal-lateral region and increasing spatial dispersion moving ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with at least four primary horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like matrix of anchor nodes along the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing surface and a low-intensity shadow vector on the ventral-facing surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs, concentrated primarily within the anterior and mid-sections of the fin's lateral silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 6-8 small teleost fish (likely remoras) is visible in the lower-left quadrant, positioned immediately inferior to the pectoral fin's ventral margin.
